newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish retailer wants H1 1997 Warsaw bourse entry.
newsitem.headline: Polish retailer wants H1 1997 Warsaw bourse entry.

text.p: Polish retailer Best SA plans a public offering of one million shares and floating its existing 500,000 shares later this year and wants to enter the Warsaw bourse next year, the president of the company said.
"We are planning a public issue this year and our shares should start to trade on the bourse in the first half of 1997," Wojciech Zurawik told Reuters.
Zurawik said the issue price would be set no lower than 32 zlotys per share and that the company wanted to use the shares for developing its leasing activities.
The company, based in the nothern Polish city of Sopot had a net profit of 1.3 million zlotys in the first half of 1996 on 17.3 million zloty turnover.
The company expects to earn 3.1 million zlotys in the whole 1996 on 34-million zloty turnover.
